- [ ] 重构 / Refactor

## 验证 / Verification

- [ ] `python -m pytest tests -q`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] 已运行与本次改动相关的额外检查，并在下方说明。/ Relevant additional checks were run and are described below.

<!-- 额外检查结果 / Additional check results -->

## 提交前确认 / Checklist

- [ ] 我已阅读 [贡献指南 / Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md)。
- [ ] 我已搜索重复的 Issue 和 PR。
- [ ] 我没有提交 `.env`、API 密钥、聊天记录、数据库、运行日志或其他敏感数据。
- [ ] 代码、测试和文档已同步更新，或我已说明为什么不需要更新。
- [ ] 该 PR 聚焦于一个主题；如仍在讨论中，我已将其标记为 Draft。
- [ ] 我同意本项目的 [AGPL v3.0 许可](../LICENSE)及适用的附加条款。

- [ ] I have read the [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I searched for duplicate Issues and PRs.
- [ ] I did not include `.env` files, API keys, chat transcripts, databases, runtime logs, or other sensitive data.
- [ ] Code, tests, and documentation are synchronized, or I explained why an update is unnecessary.
- [ ] This PR is focused on one topic; I marked it as Draft if discussion is still ongoing.
- [ ] I agree to the project’s [AGPL v3.0 license](../LICENSE) and applicable additional terms.
